fact: The Ministry of Justice launched an online system at eservices.gov.et for service users to lodge complaints and grievances on decided criminal case files, covering Addis Ababa branch offices, Dire Dawa and Hawassa.
title: ባለጉዳዮች ባሉበት ሆነዉ ቅሬታንና አቤቱታን ማቅረብ የሚያስችል የኦንላይን ሲስተም ወደ ስራ ገባ / Online System Launched for Stakeholders to Submit Complaints and Grievances Remotely
